d: Mahaparv chhath udiyman bhagvan bhaskar ko arghy arpit karne ke sath sanpann ho gaya. subah se hi rajyabhar ke vibhinn chhath ghaton par shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umri aur vratiyon ne ugte sury ko arghy dekar parivar ki sukh-samriddhi aur lokkalyan ki kamna ki. iske sath hi chhattis ghante ke nirjala upvas ka paran huaa aur char divsiy chhath mahaparv ka samapan ho gaya. vahin, pradhanmantri narendr modi philipins ke daure par ravana ho gae hain. apne daure ke dauran pradhanmantri aasiyan-bharat shikhar sammelan aur purvi eshiya shikhar sammelan men hissa lenge. manila men aayojit in…
